name: app
note: source/app is the app's own production build (npm run build in toyz-pixel-kit); it is not committed. The same screens are live at https://pixel-kit.toyz.kr. The app's first-run library holds sample designs for its three fictional kits (숨결 요가 스튜디오, 모래알 베이커리, PADO Coffee Roasters); each of three is opened from the library and its consistency board (일관성 보기) is captured: the app's own renderer drawing the same design in six sizes. The template list (13 templates in the 숨결 kit) and the kit cards are captured too.
